newsitem.title: USA: Hathaway takes 5.8 pct Peerless stake.
newsitem.headline: Hathaway takes 5.8 pct Peerless stake.

text.p: Peerless Group Inc said on Monday Hathaway Partners Investment Ltd Partnership of Rowayton, Connecticut, acquired 300,000 shares of Peerless's stock or 5.8 percent of its total common stock outstanding.
In its 13D filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Hathaway indicated the purchases were for investment purposes only, Peerless said.
"We welcome Hathaway Partners' investment in our company and appreciate their interest in our business," Peerless Chairman Rodney Armstrong Jr said.
Peerless designs, develops, installs and supports integrated information systems.
